verdict.rationale: Highnote's spend rules and collaborative authorization show that MCC and real-time decision logic are part of authorization events (docs-7, docs-8, docs-29), but there is no evidence of merchant name, enhanced merchant data, wallet/entry-mode details, or partial-approval/incremental-auth signals being exposed in the authorization payload. missing for 10: merchant name field, enhanced merchant data, wallet/entry-mode details, partial-approval and incremental-auth signal documentation.
